source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When an attached unit is the target of an attack and still includes bodyguard models, resolve the attack with the highest T found among those bodyguard models, even if a leader or support unit within it has a different T. If only leader or support models are left, use the highest T among them instead. For an attached unit, rules triggered by a unit being destroyed trigger only once the last of the models it began the battle with is destroyed.
